svg.title: The extraction (SH1)–(SH3) for nonlinear path books alone remains subsequential. The auxil- iary response comparison is used through exactly the orders it supplies: base matching through the second jet, then cubic and quartic comparisons (SH7), and the loop second-jet comparison (SH8). In particular any two extractions share the second profile jet, since it is the same quadratic matrix limit just proved. The recursive first-unmatched-jet argument compares the next two jets with their stated bounds. It does not assert equality of arbitrary all-order path books or field-independent scalar offsets. Whenever the subsequent primitive-continuity argument uses common path coef- ficients, its two sequences are taken from the already selected common book refinement. Full quadratic-row convergence and retained nonlinear-book convergence thus have different, explicit scopes.
